examples.en: He wore a white shirt to work.
examples.zh: 他穿了件白衬衫去上班。

examples.en: This shirt is too big for me.
examples.zh: 这件衬衫对我来说太大了。

mnemonic.tip: shirt 谐音「绍特」——上身穿的、带领子扣扣子的就是衬衫。

examples.en: These trousers are too long.
He bought a pair of black trousers.

mnemonic.tip: trousers 谐音「抓着子」——两条裤腿总成对，永远用复数(a pair of)。

examples.en: She wears jeans every day.
My jeans have a hole in them.

mnemonic.tip: jeans 谐音「记恩子」——耐磨的蓝布裤子就是牛仔裤(总用复数)。

examples.en: She wore a red dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了条红裙子去聚会。

examples.en: He dressed quickly and left.
examples.zh: 他很快穿好衣服就走了。

mnemonic.tip: dress 谐音「抓死」——上下连体的裙子就是 dress；动词是「穿衣」。

examples.en: The skirt is blue with white spots.
examples.zh: 这条裙子是蓝底白点的。

examples.en: She wore a long skirt.

mnemonic.tip: skirt 谐音「斯克特」——只围下半身的就是半身裙(区别 dress 连衣裙)。

examples.en: Put on your jacket; it's cold.
His leather jacket looks cool.
examples.zh: 他的皮夹克看起来很酷。

mnemonic.tip: jacket 谐音「夹克特」——短款的上身外套就是夹克。

examples.en: Wear a warm coat in winter.
She hung her coat by the door.

mnemonic.tip: coat 谐音「扣它」——套在最外面、扣起来御寒的长外套就是大衣。

examples.en: My grandma knitted this sweater.
examples.zh: 这件毛衣是我奶奶织的。

examples.en: Wear a sweater under your coat.

mnemonic.tip: sweater 里有 sweat(出汗)，穿上厚毛衣暖得直冒汗，就是毛衣。

examples.en: He wore a smart suit to the interview.
examples.zh: 他穿了套笔挺的西装去面试。

examples.en: This colour suits you.

mnemonic.tip: suit 谐音「苏特」——上下配套、正式的一身就是西装；动词义「适合」。

examples.en: He wears a tie to work.
The tie matches his shirt.
examples.zh: 这条领带和他的衬衫很搭。

mnemonic.tip: tie 本义「系/打结」，在脖子上打个结的布条就是领带。

examples.en: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
examples.zh: 她在脖子上围了条围巾。

examples.en: This wool scarf is very warm.

mnemonic.tip: scarf 谐音「斯卡夫」——绕在脖子上保暖的就是围巾。

examples.en: Wear gloves; it's freezing outside.
She lost one of her gloves.

mnemonic.tip: glove 谐音「格拉夫」——里面藏 love，像双手被温暖「爱」着的就是手套。

examples.en: She wore a big sun hat.
Take off your hat indoors.

mnemonic.tip: hat 谐音「嗨」——扣在头(head)上、打招呼「嗨」一下抬手碰的就是帽子。

examples.en: He wears a baseball cap.
Turn your cap around.

mnemonic.tip: cap 是前面带檐、无边的软帽，和 hat(有整圈檐)区分开。

examples.en: Put on clean socks.
One of my socks is missing.

mnemonic.tip: socks 谐音「扫克斯」——套在脚上的短筒就是袜子(成对用复数)。

examples.en: She wore boots in the snow.
These boots keep my feet dry.
examples.zh: 这双靴子让我的脚保持干爽。

mnemonic.tip: boots 谐音「布次」——包住脚踝、高帮的鞋就是靴子。

examples.en: He bought new trainers for running.
examples.zh: 他买了双新运动鞋来跑步。

examples.en: My trainers are muddy.

mnemonic.tip: train(训练/运动)+ers，运动训练时穿的鞋就是 trainers(英式；美式 sneakers)。

examples.en: He tightened his belt.
The trousers need a belt.
examples.zh: 这条裤子需要系条腰带。

mnemonic.tip: belt 谐音「绷它」——把裤子在腰上「绷」住的带子就是腰带。

examples.en: He put the keys in his pocket.
This coat has deep pockets.

mnemonic.tip: pocket 谐音「泡克特」——衣服上装小东西的袋子就是口袋。

examples.en: A button came off my shirt.
Press the button to start.

mnemonic.tip: button 谐音「巴顿」——扣衣服的小圆片就是纽扣；机器上按的也叫 button。

examples.en: The zip on my bag is broken.
Do up the zip on your coat.

mnemonic.tip: zip 拟声「滋~」——拉上时「滋」一声的就是拉链。

examples.en: He rolled up his sleeves.
The shirt has short sleeves.

mnemonic.tip: sleeve 谐音「斯利夫」——手臂伸进去的那截布筒就是袖子。

examples.en: Students wear a uniform to school.
The nurse's uniform is white.

mnemonic.tip: uni(单一/统一)+form(形式)，大家穿成统一样式就是制服。

examples.en: She follows the latest fashion.
These shoes are back in fashion.

mnemonic.tip: fashion 谐音「发神」——一到换季就发神经般追新款就是时尚。

examples.en: I like the style of this coat.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这件外套的款式。

examples.en: She has her own style.

mnemonic.tip: style 谐音「斯代欧」——穿衣打扮的独特「派头」就是风格。

examples.en: She wears glasses to read.
What will you wear tomorrow?

mnemonic.tip: wear 表「穿着的状态」(过去式 wore)；put on 才是「穿上」的动作。

examples.en: We dressed up for the wedding.
The kids dressed up as animals.

mnemonic.tip: dress(穿衣)+up(向上/更盛)，把自己打扮得更隆重就是盛装打扮。

examples.en: This dress fits me well.
The shoes don't fit.

mnemonic.tip: fit 也指「健康的」，衣服像贴身一样「正合适」就是合身。

examples.en: He likes loose clothes.
This belt is too loose.

mnemonic.tip: loose(松)有两个 o，像松松垮垮的两个圈；lose(丢)只有一个 o，别搞混。

examples.en: These jeans are too tight.
The shoes feel a bit tight.

mnemonic.tip: tight 谐音「太的」——紧得「太」贴身、勒得慌就是 tight。

examples.en: This T-shirt is made of cotton.
Cotton feels soft and cool.
examples.zh: 棉料摸起来又软又凉爽。

mnemonic.tip: cotton 谐音「卡疼」——棉花做的、软软透气的布料就是棉。

examples.en: The sweater is made of wool.
Wool keeps you warm in winter.

mnemonic.tip: wool 谐音「呜」——绵羊身上「咩」下的暖毛就是羊毛。

examples.en: She carries a leather bag.
Leather shoes last a long time.

mnemonic.tip: leather 谐音「莱泽」——动物皮鞣制成的料子就是皮革。

examples.en: The changing room is over there.
She tried the dress in the changing room.
examples.zh: 她在试衣间试了那条裙子。

mnemonic.tip: changing(更换)+room(房间)，换衣服的小房间就是试衣间。

examples.en: Wear a raincoat in the rain.
Her raincoat is bright yellow.

mnemonic.tip: rain(雨)+coat(外套)，挡雨的外套就是雨衣。

examples.en: He looks smart in that suit.
Wear something smart for the party.

mnemonic.tip: smart 除了「聪明」，还形容穿着「利落体面」——打扮得精神就是 smart。

examples.en: He wore a plain white T-shirt and jeans.
examples.zh: 他穿着纯白T恤和牛仔裤。

examples.en: The band sold T-shirts at the concert.

mnemonic.tip: 平铺开像字母 T 的衬衫→T-shirt。

examples.en: We wear shorts for PE in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天上体育课我们穿短裤。

examples.en: He packed two pairs of shorts for the beach.
examples.zh: 他为海滩之行带了两条短裤。

mnemonic.tip: short(短)+s→短的裤子→短裤；恒用复数。

examples.en: Her school blouse has a small collar.
examples.zh: 她的校服衬衫有个小领子。

examples.en: Mum bought a silk blouse for the wedding.
examples.zh: 妈妈买了件真丝衬衫参加婚礼。

mnemonic.tip: blouse 谐音「不劳斯」——淑女衬衫，优雅不劳。

examples.en: He hides his headphones under his hoodie.
examples.zh: 他把耳机藏在连帽衫里。

examples.en: This hoodie is so warm and soft.

mnemonic.tip: hood(兜帽)+ie→带帽子的上衣→连帽衫。

examples.en: Grandma knitted me a blue cardigan.
examples.zh: 奶奶给我织了件蓝色开衫。

examples.en: Take a cardigan—it gets cold at night.

mnemonic.tip: cardigan 谐音「卡了根」——开衫扣子一排像卡了根线。

examples.en: The waiter wore a black waistcoat.
His suit came with a matching waistcoat.
examples.zh: 他的西装配了件同色马甲。

mnemonic.tip: waist(腰)+coat(外衣)→只到腰的外衣→马甲。

examples.en: Put on your pyjamas and brush your teeth.
She stayed in her pyjamas all Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日上午她一直穿着睡衣。

mnemonic.tip: pyjamas 谐音「扒枕么事」——穿上睡衣扒着枕头睡觉。

examples.en: Pack enough underwear for the week.
Put your clean underwear in the drawer.

mnemonic.tip: under(下面)+wear(穿)→穿在里面的→内衣。

examples.en: He wears a vest under his shirt in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天他在衬衫里穿件汗衫。

examples.en: The runners all wore yellow vests.
examples.zh: 跑步的人都穿着黄背心。

mnemonic.tip: vest 谐音「围死它」——背心紧紧围住上身。

examples.en: She wore black tights with her skirt.
My tights have a hole in them!

mnemonic.tip: tight(紧)+s→紧紧包住腿的袜子→连裤袜。

examples.en: Don't forget your swimsuit for the pool party.
examples.zh: 别忘了带泳衣去泳池派对。

examples.en: Her new swimsuit is bright orange.
examples.zh: 她的新泳衣是亮橙色的。

mnemonic.tip: swim(游泳)+suit(套装)→游泳穿的衣服→泳衣。

examples.en: Sandals are perfect for hot weather.
She bought leather sandals for the holiday.

mnemonic.tip: sandals 谐音「沙滩喽」——去沙滩就穿凉鞋喽。

examples.en: Put on your slippers—the floor is cold.
The dog brought Dad his slippers.

mnemonic.tip: slip(滑入)+pers→脚一滑就穿进去的鞋→拖鞋。

examples.en: She can't run in high heels.
Mum only wears high heels at weddings.
examples.zh: 妈妈只在婚礼上穿高跟鞋。

mnemonic.tip: high(高)+heels(鞋跟)→高跟鞋。

examples.en: Put on your wellies and let's jump in puddles!
examples.zh: 穿上雨靴，我们去踩水坑！

examples.en: His wellies are covered in mud.

mnemonic.tip: 得名于 Wellington 公爵——他带火了这种靴子。

examples.en: Your shoelace is undone—you'll trip!
He learned to tie his shoelaces at five.

mnemonic.tip: shoe(鞋)+lace(带子)→鞋带。

examples.en: He turned up his collar against the wind.
The dog wears a red collar.

mnemonic.tip: collar 谐音「卡脖」——领子卡着脖子。

examples.en: His shirt cuffs were dirty from painting.
examples.zh: 他的衬衫袖口画画时弄脏了。

examples.en: She rolled up her cuffs to wash the dishes.

mnemonic.tip: cuff 谐音「卡夫」——袖口卡在手腕处。

examples.en: Put your hood up—it's starting to rain.
The coat has a warm hood with fur.

mnemonic.tip: hood 兜帽——hoodie 连帽衫就是「带 hood 的衣服」。

examples.en: The belt has a silver buckle.
Buckle your seat belt before we go.

mnemonic.tip: buckle 谐音「扒扣」——扒开再扣上→搭扣。

examples.en: The strap of my school bag broke.
Her watch has a leather strap.

mnemonic.tip: strap 谐音「死拽」——带子拽得紧紧的。

examples.en: She chose a new outfit for the first day of school.
examples.zh: 她为开学第一天挑了套新衣服。

examples.en: His superhero outfit won the costume prize.
examples.zh: 他的超级英雄套装赢了服装奖。

mnemonic.tip: out(出门)+fit(合身搭配)→出门穿的一整套→套装。

examples.en: The actors wore colourful costumes.
What costume will you wear to the party?
examples.zh: 化装派对你穿什么服装？

mnemonic.tip: custom(风俗)同源——按角色风俗打扮的衣服→戏服/化装服。

examples.en: Belts and bags are popular accessories.
The shop sells phone cases and other accessories.
examples.zh: 这家店卖手机壳等配件。

mnemonic.tip: access(附加)+ory→附加在主装之外的小物→配饰。

examples.en: She wears her grandmother's pearl necklace.
examples.zh: 她戴着祖母的珍珠项链。

examples.en: The gold necklace shone in the light.
examples.zh: 金项链在灯下闪闪发光。

mnemonic.tip: neck(脖子)+lace(带)→戴在脖子上的链→项链。

examples.en: The friendship bracelet was a gift from Lily.
examples.zh: 这条友谊手链是莉莉送的。

examples.en: She made bracelets from coloured beads.

mnemonic.tip: bracelet 谐音「不来受累」——戴上手链，好看不累。

examples.en: Mum lost one of her gold earrings.
These earrings match your dress perfectly.
examples.zh: 这对耳环和你的裙子很配。

mnemonic.tip: ear(耳朵)+rings(环)→耳朵上的环→耳环。

examples.en: Her handbag matches her shoes.
examples.zh: 她的手提包和鞋子很配。

examples.en: The keys are in my handbag.

mnemonic.tip: hand(手)+bag(包)→手上提的包。

examples.en: He packed his rucksack for the hiking trip.
examples.zh: 他为徒步旅行收拾好背包。

examples.en: My rucksack is heavy with books.

mnemonic.tip: rucksack 谐音「拉起塞个」——拉开背包塞东西。

examples.en: My watch says half past three.
He got a sports watch for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他生日收到一块运动手表。

mnemonic.tip: watch 看——手表就是随时「看」时间的东西。

examples.en: She wore sunglasses on the beach.
examples.zh: 她在海滩上戴着太阳镜。

examples.en: I left my sunglasses in the car.
examples.zh: 我把太阳镜落在车里了。

mnemonic.tip: sun(太阳)+glasses(眼镜)→挡太阳的眼镜。

examples.en: The scarf is made of Chinese silk.
examples.zh: 这条围巾是中国丝绸做的。

examples.en: Silk feels smooth and cool.

mnemonic.tip: silk 谐音「丝哦克」——丝滑的面料→丝绸。

examples.en: He wore a denim jacket over his T-shirt.
examples.zh: 他T恤外面套了件牛仔夹克。

examples.en: Denim is strong and lasts for years.

mnemonic.tip: 来自法国城市 de Nîmes(尼姆)——牛仔布的老家。

examples.en: The tent is made of light nylon.
Nylon dries much faster than cotton.

mnemonic.tip: nylon 音译「尼龙」——中英同音。

examples.en: The queen wore a dress of red velvet.
examples.zh: 女王穿着红天鹅绒长裙。

examples.en: The box is lined with soft velvet.
examples.zh: 盒子内衬柔软的天鹅绒。

mnemonic.tip: velvet 谐音「微软微特」——摸起来特别软→天鹅绒。

examples.en: I like the flower pattern on your dress.
examples.zh: 我喜欢你裙子上的花朵图案。

examples.en: The carpet has a beautiful star pattern.
examples.zh: 地毯上有漂亮的星形花纹。

mnemonic.tip: pattern 谐音「拍疼」——花纹印上去要拍打。

examples.en: He wore a blue and white striped shirt.
Zebras have striped coats.

mnemonic.tip: stripe(条纹)+d→带条纹的。

examples.en: She wore a red spotted dress.
examples.zh: 她穿着红色圆点连衣裙。

examples.en: The spotted bow tie made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 那个圆点领结逗笑了大家。

mnemonic.tip: spot(圆点)+ted→带圆点的。

examples.en: Dad loves his old checked shirt.
examples.zh: 爸爸最爱他那件旧格子衬衫。

examples.en: The tablecloth is red and white checked.

mnemonic.tip: check 棋盘格——checked 像棋盘一样的格子花纹。

examples.en: She prefers plain clothes without patterns.
examples.zh: 她喜欢没有图案的素色衣服。

examples.en: The cake was plain but delicious.

mnemonic.tip: plain 素净无花纹；plane 飞机——同音不同拼。

examples.en: The dancers wore colourful traditional clothes.
examples.zh: 舞者穿着色彩鲜艳的传统服装。

examples.en: Her room is bright and colourful.

mnemonic.tip: colour(颜色)+ful(满)→满是颜色的→鲜艳的。

examples.en: The school held a fashion show for charity.
examples.zh: 学校办了场慈善时装秀。

examples.en: Models walked slowly down the stage at the fashion show.
examples.zh: 时装秀上模特们缓缓走过舞台。

mnemonic.tip: fashion(时装)+show(秀)→时装秀。

examples.en: Long coats are in fashion this winter.
Are these trainers still in fashion?

mnemonic.tip: in fashion 在潮流「里面」→正流行；out of fashion 过时。

examples.en: He wears old-fashioned glasses like his grandpa's.
examples.zh: 他戴着像爷爷那样的老式眼镜。

examples.en: The shop sells old-fashioned sweets.

mnemonic.tip: old(旧)+fashioned(样式的)→旧样式的→过时的。

examples.en: She always looks stylish, even in school uniform.
examples.zh: 她连穿校服都显得有型。

examples.en: The café has stylish black and white chairs.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆里摆着时尚的黑白椅子。

mnemonic.tip: style(风格)+ish→有风格的→时髦的。

examples.en: That's a trendy haircut!
The trendy shop is full of teenagers.
examples.zh: 这家新潮小店挤满青少年。

mnemonic.tip: trend(潮流)+y→跟着潮流走的→新潮的。

examples.en: She looked elegant in the long black dress.
examples.zh: 她穿黑色长裙显得很优雅。

examples.en: The hotel lobby is simple but elegant.

mnemonic.tip: elegant 谐音「爱丽根」——爱丽丝般优雅有根底。

examples.en: We can wear casual clothes on Fridays.
He looked casual in jeans and a T-shirt.
examples.zh: 他穿牛仔裤和T恤，一副休闲打扮。

mnemonic.tip: casual 谐音「卡竖」——不用卡着竖领带，轻松随意。

examples.en: You need a waterproof jacket for hiking.
examples.zh: 徒步需要一件防水外套。

examples.en: My watch is waterproof to fifty metres.

mnemonic.tip: water(水)+proof(防)→防水的。

examples.en: She wore a sleeveless dress in the heat.
examples.zh: 大热天她穿了条无袖连衣裙。

examples.en: A sleeveless top is cooler for sports.
examples.zh: 运动穿无袖上衣更凉快。

mnemonic.tip: sleeve(袖子)+less(无)→没袖子的。

examples.en: Baggy trousers are back in fashion.
examples.zh: 肥大的裤子又流行起来了。

examples.en: He likes baggy T-shirts two sizes too big.
examples.zh: 他爱穿大两号的宽松T恤。

mnemonic.tip: bag(袋子)+gy→像套了个袋子→宽松肥大。

examples.en: Get dressed quickly or you'll be late.
examples.zh: 快穿衣服，不然要迟到了。

examples.en: The baby can nearly get dressed by himself.
examples.zh: 宝宝差不多能自己穿衣服了。

mnemonic.tip: get dressed 完成「穿好」这个过程——比 wear(穿着) 强调动作。

examples.en: Put on your coat—it's cold outside.
She put on her glasses to read the menu.

mnemonic.tip: put on 动作「穿上」；wear 状态「穿着」——考试常考区别。

examples.en: Take off your shoes at the door.
The plane took off on time.

mnemonic.tip: 脱衣服和飞机起飞都是 take off——都是「离开原处」。

examples.en: Hang up your uniform after school.
She said goodbye and hung up.
examples.zh: 她说了再见就挂了电话。

mnemonic.tip: hang(挂)+up(起)→挂起来；打电话时代表挂断。

examples.en: Fold your clothes and put them in the case.
He folded the letter in half.

mnemonic.tip: fold 谐音「佛的」——衣服叠得整整齐齐像打坐。

examples.en: Does this scarf go with my coat?
examples.zh: 这条围巾配我的外套吗？

examples.en: White trainers go with almost everything.

mnemonic.tip: go with 走到一起→搭配得来。

examples.en: Grandma mended the hole in my jumper.
examples.zh: 奶奶补好了我毛衣上的洞。

examples.en: Can these old shoes be mended?

mnemonic.tip: mend 与 amend(修正)同根——把破的补回好→缝补。

examples.en: Wash this sweater in cold water.
I washed my school shirt for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我把校服衬衫洗了明天穿。

examples.en: My favourite T-shirt shrank in the wash.
Wool shrinks in hot water.

mnemonic.tip: shrink 谐音「缩瑞克」——洗完衣服缩了一圈。

examples.en: The blue jeans faded after many washes.
examples.zh: 牛仔裤洗多了就褪色了。

examples.en: The poster has faded in the sun.
examples.zh: 海报被太阳晒得褪色了。

mnemonic.tip: fade 谐音「费的」——颜色费掉了→褪色。

examples.en: There's a juice stain on your shirt.
The grass stained his white trousers green.
examples.zh: 草把他的白裤子染绿了。

mnemonic.tip: stain 谐音「死擦」——污渍死擦也擦不掉。

examples.en: Zip up your jacket—the wind is cold.
He zipped up his bag and left.

mnemonic.tip: zip(拉链)+up(上)→把拉链拉到顶。

examples.en: He wears out a pair of trainers every term.
examples.zh: 他每学期穿坏一双运动鞋。

examples.en: These jeans are completely worn out.
examples.zh: 这条牛仔裤彻底穿烂了。

mnemonic.tip: wear(穿)+out(完)→穿到报废；累坏了也叫 worn out。

examples.en: She made breakfast in her dressing gown.
Put on your dressing gown—it's chilly.

mnemonic.tip: dressing(穿衣)+gown(长袍)→起床后披的袍子。

examples.en: Actors wear make-up on stage.
She doesn't wear make-up to school.

mnemonic.tip: make(做)+up(起来)→把脸「做」起来→化妆。

examples.en: The perfume smells of roses.
Mum only uses perfume on special days.
examples.zh: 妈妈只在特别日子喷香水。

mnemonic.tip: per(穿透)+fume(烟气)→香气穿透空气→香水。

examples.en: Dad wears a funny apron when he cooks.
examples.zh: 爸爸做饭时系着搞笑围裙。

examples.en: Put on an apron before you paint.

mnemonic.tip: apron 谐音「爱普通」——系上围裙爱做普通家务。

examples.en: What material is this dress made of?
examples.zh: 这条裙子是什么面料做的？

examples.en: The sofa is covered in soft material.

mnemonic.tip: mater(母亲)+ial→万物之「母」→材料。
